statements.t: We are also making excellent progress advancing our ongoing Phase 3 study in symptomatic dermographism and cold urticaria and look forward to updating on these programs in 2027.

“Building on our leading science clinically validating the therapeutic potential of KIT inhibition in immune and inflammatory diseases, we will continue to chart the future of mast cell medicine, expanding barzolvolimab and CDX-622 development across a diverse spectrum of immune and inflammatory diseases and adding to our growing mast cell targeted pipeline to bring our science to additional patient populations…
Treatment in both EMBARQ-CSU trials will continue to 52 weeks, and the Company anticipates a BLA submission in 2027.
The Company plans to advance expansion into additional indications with CDX-622, including allergic rhinitis and food allergy.

risks.t: the uncertainties inherent in clinical testing and accruing patients for clinical trials
our limited experience in bringing programs through Phase 3 clinical trials
our current expectations regarding the submission of a Biologics License Application (“BLA”) to the FDA in 2027
the timing, cost and uncertainty of obtaining regulatory approvals
the failure of the market for the Company's programs to continue to develop
our ability to protect the Company's intellectual property
the loss of any executive officers or key personnel or consultants
changes in the regulatory landscape or the imposition of regulations that affect the Company's products
